# arrowlane

> Columnar data lanes for ingress and egress in containerized Python apps. Python 3.14 or newer.

## Start here

- [docs/ai/operating-guide.md](docs/ai/operating-guide.md): operating guide for coding agents.
- [docs/ai/manifest.json](docs/ai/manifest.json): machine-readable capabilities and limits.
- [docs/ai/quickstart.md](docs/ai/quickstart.md): install and first call.
- [docs/ai/api.md](docs/ai/api.md): signatures, errors and limits.
- [docs/ai/recipes.md](docs/ai/recipes.md): integration patterns.
- [README.md](README.md): product overview.
- [docs/ADR](docs/ADR): design decisions.

## Commands

- `bash scripts/gate.sh`
- `arrowlane describe --indent 0`
- `python bench/verify.py`
- `bash demo/verify.sh`
